description:
In rnews_main.rs the article processing loop increments `accepted` on `run_pipeline` Ok (line 318), but `run_pipeline` returns Ok with `groups: []` when the group filter rejects every Newsgroup in the article (or when every group name is invalid). The operator sees 'accepted' in the batch-complete log line but the article is invisible to the reader: it has a CID in msgid_map and the articles table, but zero group-log entries. This is the 'appears to work but does nothing' pattern for group-filtered deployments.

Fix: after `run_pipeline` succeeds, check whether `result.groups.is_empty()`. If so, log a warn with the message-id and increment `rejected` rather than `accepted`, or add a distinct `filtered` counter with a summary log line. Either way the operator can diagnose from logs alone.
title: rnews_main: group-filtered article counted as 'accepted' but has no group log entries
